errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis range from 2.5 to 10.0, not 11.25. While the data points extend to x=11.25, this is not the range of the labeled axis.

The 'Consistency-CE' line (light purple circle) starts at a BLEU score of approximately 25.8, which is the lowest of the three lines starting at AL=2.5. The description incorrectly states the value as 26.1, misrepresenting its rank among the models.
The 'Consistency-CE' line ends at a BLEU score of approximately 31.4, not 31.6. The reported value is an overestimation.

The 'Inconsistency-CE' line (dark purple square) starts at a BLEU score of approximately 26.0. The description incorrectly reports 26.2, which is the approximate starting value for the 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' line.

The 'Inconsistency-CE' line ends at a BLEU score of approximately 31.4, not 31.7. The overestimation incorrectly suggests it ends at a higher score than the 'Consistency-CE' line, when they are visually at the same level.

The 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' line (blue square) starts at a BLEU score of approximately 26.2, which is the highest of the three lines at AL=2.5. The description incorrectly reports 25.8, which is the starting value for the 'Consistency-CE' line.

The 'Consistency-Bi' line (red star) ends at a BLEU score of approximately 31.8. The value 32.3 is an overestimation and incorrectly implies that this model has a higher final BLEU score than the 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' model (which ends at approx. 32.1), contradicting the visual evidence that the blue line ends highest.

The first data point for the 'Consistency-Bi' line is located at approximately AL=3.5, with a BLEU score of about 28.9, which is slightly below the 29.0 grid line. The stated value of 29.0 is a minor overestimation.
